# `hk util check-symlinks`

- **Usage:** `hk util check-symlinks <FILES>…`
- **Effect:** read-only

Check for broken symlinks

## Arguments

- **`<FILES>…`** — Files to check

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- hk documentation examples -->

## Examples

Check the supplied symbolic link targets.

```sh
hk util check-symlinks bin/tool
```
